cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.1 Head
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a head

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.1.1 Head Position
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Head of the Mars Rover shall be higher mounted than body, suspension and traction unit.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.1.2 Head Function
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Head of the Mars Rover shall carry sensors and a LED Display.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.2 Body
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a body

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.3 Suspension
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a suspension suspending the traction unit

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.1.4 Traction Unit
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a traction unit providing traction to the ground

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2 Power Supply
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a power supply.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.1 External Power Supply
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be operable with internal power supply only.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.2 Internal Power Supply
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a power supply fulfilling all of the following conditions: * it contains an energy storage system * it contains an energy management system * it contains a power distribution system

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.2.1 Energy Storage
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have means to re-charde its energy storage system.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.2.2 Available Power
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be operable for 4h under all of the following conditions: * The energy storage is fully loaded at the beginning * The operation requires less than or equal to 60% of the max energy in peak load * the environmental conditions are mission normal

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.3 Energy Re-Charging
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall re-charge the energy storage from 10% to 80% in 4h under the following conditions: * re-charging at mission normal conditions * no energy consumption of the Mars Rover since the re-charging period

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.5 Electrical Values
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall use 12 V DC voltage

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.5.1 Motor Voltage
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have one main drive motor for each traction device fulfilling the following conditions: * using 12 V voltage * using not more than 30 A current

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.5.2 Encoder Voltage
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have an encoder powered by 5 V voltage.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.2.4 Energy Management
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have an energy management fullfilling all of the following conditions: * distributing the energy to all systems * prioritizing the energy available for the different systems * limiting energy to individual systems to prioritize individual systems * managing energy that the Mars Rover can recharge by itself in a time period of less than 24 hours

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3 Motion
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move by itself.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.2 Motion over Obstacles
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move by itself over obstacles which fullfill one of the following condition: * the obstacle is max. 20 cm high * the slope angle uphil is max. 30 degree * the slope angle downhil is max. 30 degree * the roll angle of the Mars Rover since moving over the obstacle never exceeds an angle of 30 degree

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.2.1 Deformation of the bogie
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The bogie of the suspension system shall not bend more than 5% since all motion events.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.2.2 Plastic deformation of the bogie
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The bogie of the suspension system shall not deform plastically for bending less than or equal to 7%.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.4 Motion Ground Contact
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall produce a ground pressure of max. 20 kPa.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.1 Max Motion Speed
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move by itself with a max. speed of 7 m/s.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.3 Motion over slopes
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move on slopes which fullfill the following condition: * slope angle uphill max. 20 degree * slope angle downhill max. 30 degree * slope angle sidehill max 15 degree

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.5 Electric Motion Drive
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have one left and one right traction device both driven by one electrical motor each.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.8 Motion Distance
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move at least 100m per day on all slopes where it is able to move on.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.7 Min Motion Speed
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to move by itself with a min. speed of 1 m/min

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.6 Start Driving
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall start driving by itself on all slopes where it is able to move on.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.9 Stopping
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to stop moving by itself down to 0 m/s speed.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.10 Hill Holding
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall maintain 0 m/s motion on all slopes it is able to move on.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.11 Steering
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to change driving direction to the left and to the right.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.12 Diving Direction
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to drive forwards and backwards.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.13 Navigate
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to calculate a route between its actual position and a target position

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.13.1 Detecting Obstacles
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to identify obstacles by itself

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.13.2 Map Data
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have map data stored enabling it to calculate a route between its actual position and a target position

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.3.13.3 Preventing Obstacles
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall prevent driving over obstacles if all of the following conditions are true: * the obstacle exceeds the measures of an acceptable obstacle as required in 1.1.3.2 * a rout is available around the obstacle or rearwards to a position capable to reach the target without crossing the obstacle.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.4 Remote Control
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be controllable remote.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.4.2 Remote Steering
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover steering direction shall be controllable remote.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.4.1 Remote Speed Control
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover speed shall be controllable remote.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.4.3 Remote Control Priority
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover remote control shall be able to overrule the auto navigation function.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.5 Optical Feedback
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall provide optical information if it is operable or not.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.5.1 LED
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a LED for optical information if it is operable or not.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.6 Max Mass
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a total mass of not more than 12 kg

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.6.1 Mars Rover Mass
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a total mass of not more than 10 kg

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.6.2 Payload
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall have a payload of 2 kg.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.7 Mars Rover Capabilities
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to execute the following operations individually and not in combination: * Moving on Mars surface * Capturing optical information * Capturing video information * Capturing audio information * Sampling of Probes of solid material of individual diameter not bigger than 20 mm * Sampling of probes of fluid material in the range of ph-value 0 to 11 * Sampling of probes of gas of not more than 50 mm³ volume and pressure between 1 hPa up to 3.000 hPa * Sampling of biological probes of not more than 50 mm³ volume and not more than 30 mm length in any direction

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.7.1 Mars Rover Communication
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to communicate sampled information to the Mars station.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.7.2 Information Storage
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be capable to store information up to 2 TB

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.7.3 Sample Storage
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to store probes up to 48 h long.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.7.4 Unloading
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to unload stored probes into the Mars Station.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.9 Operating on Mars
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to operate on the planet Mars.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.9.1 Operating Atmosphere
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to operate in Mars atmosphere for at least 25 years.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.9.2 Mars Gravity
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to operate under Mars gravity of 3.71 m/s².

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.9.3 Mars Temperatures
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to operate in a temperature range from -80°C up to 80°C

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.9.4 Mars Radiation
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to be fully operable under constant cosmic radiation of at least 250 mSv.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.8 Landing on Mars
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to land on planet Mars.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.8.1 Landing Temperatures
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall resist temperatures of not more than 100°C for not more than 7 minutes while staying full functional.

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.8.2 Landing Deceleration
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be able to withstand landing deceleration as listed below: * Deceleration from 20.000 km/h at Mars atmosphere entry to 1.500 km/h in 4 minutes. * Deceleration from 1.500 km/s to 25 m/s in 3 minutes

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.8.3 Landing speed
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall be full operable after a landing on Mars with the following conditions beeing true: * The vertical speed at ground contact is not higher than 1 m/s * The horizontal speed at graund contact is not higher than 1 m/s

cas:anEntity.dcterms:title: 2.8.4 Landing Orientation
cas:anEntity.cas:Property: The Mars Rover shall land on Mars with the traction units first contacting the ground.
